messages.subject: Extracting lavaan syntax
parts:
Hello All, 

I would like to extract the model syntax (not the lavaanified version) from the fitted model, i.e., lavaan object. For example, 

  model1 <- '
  m1 ~ b1*x
  m2 ~ b2*m1
  '

fit=sem(model, df)

Now, I would like to see if I can extract model1 from the "fit" object.

Thanks in advance,

Davood

parts:
> m1 ~ b1*x
> m2 ~ b2*m1
> '
>
> fit=sem(model, df)

Currently, you can get it from

fit@Options$model

but this may change in the future; I will create a lavInspect() argument
for this.

Yves.
